cases.case_label: Full-length L1 insertion with ~46-kb deletion in PDHX
cases.mechanism_detail: Retrotranspositional insertion of a full-length L1 (67-bp poly(A) tail) was accompanied by a ~46-kb deletion within PDHX; cleavage sites match L1 endonuclease consensus.
cases.quote: identifying a approximately 46-kb pathological genomic deletion in the PDHX gene directly linked to the insertion of a full-length L1 element
